# Several comparable items carry a comparison

## Statement
Where the material treats several comparable items the same way, a strategy that
compares them gives the reader more than one that follows a single item through.
Not yet validated against the client's own published work.

## Applies when
feature parallel_structure is yes

## Influences
- S-09 · `E-13.reader_path` — which candidate strategy survives selection.

## Conflicts
K-MAT-11 prefers the single item wherever the material shows a mechanism. Both
are tier 3, so precedence resolves it on confidence — and on whether either has
been left unreviewed past its date.

## Source
A fixture record for the knowledge loader: a candidate whose review has lapsed,
written with the highest confidence so that its demotion is the only thing that
can cost it a conflict.
